title: RC2: the first two chapters, and one correction to the editions
headline: Chapters 1 and 2 of the 30-page edition are written and attached as a draft PDF with cover A, 11 pages. The speakers' heads and bands are in; the pictures still print as boxes to come. Chapter 1 has been through every check. Security cleared it, the researcher traced it (one line about the brake does not hold) and three test readers read it. They found the problem and the 'do this now' strong, and stalled at the same two sections. Chapter 2 is not yet read by security. One correction you should know about: the editions I sent as final contain a line, 'none of it was new', that does not hold. The brake, the hold, was made that night. The scripts are fixed, and the fix prints at the next rebuild, which waits on your 'build' or 'ship'.

sections.title: Chapter 1, the checks
items: security: clear on the rails. Bret Victor is named only for his published talk, and the room is 'a room in London' (security__019).
researcher: traced; it holds except for one line about the brake. The same line in both editions was its own miss, and it says so (commit fde3fea).

Three test readers, test instruments: the problem told plainly and the 'do this now' hold. All three stall at 'Pressing play' (the long quoted passage about an animation they cannot see) and 'Inventing on principle' (a 2012 talk, two lines would do). Their four changes are with the writer (review/synthetic/rc2/30/01).
librarian: quotes word for word; the two third-person lines are now in your voice (the writer, at chapter 2's wake).

sections.title: Also
items: The publisher pushed once past a gate finding: two members both claimed the RC2 build list. It saw this and fixed it at once by moving the list into its own area, and it says so (publisher__033).
designer: pictures for chapters 1 and 2 in LAB 37. ruv-sgit: chapter 3's afternoon loop drawn as LAB 29, from the register.
